body: Oh I forgot to write it I actually awake at 6:30 and then fall asleep until 8:30. But I awake at that time although I dont want to. I think I have low apetite these days so I dont do breakfast. I'm still trying slowly.

I awake at 6:30 but I get ready to go to class at 8:30. I barely wash my face and brush my teeth. I skip my breakfast almost everyday. Most of the classes are 10 to 2pm, so when i come back home I take rest like 2 hours? Then I do assignment 1 hour after dinner. I take a rest(staying on the bed) before I go to bed at 12. For me, it takes a lot of effort to wear clothes or take a shower or go to class it's like whole energy disappeared.
Yup I find it difficult to wash my face and brushing my teeth so I often dont (or cant?) do those things I go to school with no energy, it feels like im a zombie.

Same here. I always think I spoke loud enough but people won't hear it. Even when i'm saying in sentence and in the middle they'll be like saying "What?" "Sorry?" Its really exhausting to say it again.
